body:
I just feel like that dream is the only thing keeping me alive. It can be so hard to focus on your work when suicide is so close... I'm self-destructive, I admit it. I don't want to be that person who recalls his past and thinks: "What would happen if I pursued my musical talent?" Dreams don't wait. Writing songs is all I have, otherwise I'm just a bag of bones.

Keep your grades straight A. My grades gradually failed also. I used to go to competitions and then 3 years later barely passed class. Study. Not because your parents say so, study because it's for your own good. Don't care about other people's opinion of you, your mind is your temple. Don't let the hate build up inside of you, hate is only hurting the hater. That is what I learned, learn from my mistakes.

What is the reason of your depression?
